value: Sit in on second Guitar ! A guitar, chord charts, and an amp are provided but feel free to use your own guitar. You don’t need to know the songs fully, that’s what we are here for, so just have fun and follow along with the chord chart. This is karaoke so the singers call the songs, be on your toes and be prepared to play the next song up! Plan to sit in for 1-3 songs depending on signups. It goes without saying.. be respectable and play the song as best you can. Don’t solo over the entire song!!
